The institute has smart classrooms and ICT-enabled facilities across various departments and the central library.
The Central Library provides access to various digital resources including e-journals, e-books, and online databases.
There are 11 hostels for men (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, and M) and a Mega Hostel.
There are 2 hostels for women (LH and Mega Hostel for Ladies).
NITC uses an Integrated Institute Management System (IIMS) for academic and administrative processes.

column4: NIT Calicut offers B.Tech in 10 branches, B.Arch, M.Tech in 25 specializations, M.Plan, MCA, M.Sc, MBA, and PhD programs.
Tuition fee for B.Tech is Rs. 62,500 per semester. M.Tech tuition fee is Rs. 35,000 per semester.
The highest package offered during NIT Calicut placements 2024 was INR 50 LPA.
Admission to B.Tech and B.Arch programs is based on the rank secured in the Joint Entrance Examination, JEE (Main).
